# Historical FORM regression inputs

These current-format native definitions preserve the original inward geometry
for comparison and existing operation contracts. They were moved out of the
ordinary factory picker when the user selected the finished outward definitions
on 2026-10-11. They are source test inputs, not alternate production library
entries. The current library offers only `CornerGusset90.prtz` and
`VentilationWindow.prtz` under `config/lib/01-SHEETMETAL/01-FORM`.
